notes: Clear your calendar for any span: a day, a week, the next 3 months, a month by name, the rest of the year. Ervo counts what's there, asks once, and clears all of it, including the plans it made for you
Tell Ervo a birthday or anniversary and it remembers it and puts it on your calendar every year. Any date works, far ahead or back, and a vague day like "the other week" gets confirmed first

Plans ask what you want when you haven't said: meals, a diet, a week, a trip. Long messages with several asks get every part answered. A calmer gray-glass look with less purple, and Ervo's new owls everywhere
highlights: Clear any span of your calendar in one go
Gray glass look and the new owls
